benchmark: social.trend-finder.cluster_embeddings: do sentence embeddings with UMAP + HDBSCAN recover commerce topics that ECDEV's lexical clustering misses, without merging unrelated ones?

corpus.source: data/final_trendingtopics_reddit.csv in the pinned donor (not copied into ECDEV)

ground_truth: PROXY: product-line labels from brand/model mentions in smartphones, technology and gaming posts (exactly one family); token-derived labels favour lexical clustering
evidence_state: BENCHMARK_MEASUREMENT on a fixed public corpus; not evidence about any market, demand or product

harness_sources.donor_side.py:
"""Trend-Finder side of the clustering benchmark.

python -I donor_side.py <Trend-Finder checkout at 5135bb0e> <out dir>
Embeds every post with all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (pinned revision) on the donor's own text
(text_translated, else full_text), then runs the donor's unmodified cluster_embeddings
(UMAP 10-d cosine, random_state 42, then HDBSCAN min_cluster_size 10, min_samples 5, EOM) per
(niche, ISO week) — the donor's setting — and per pooled ISO week (all niches together).
Writes posts.jsonl (shared input for ECDEV) and donor.json (labels, probabilities, timings).
"""
import csv, json, pathlib, subprocess, sys, time
checkout = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve(); out = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]); out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
COMMIT = "5135bb0e2a6a3f62d3f0153554d09505075578ef"
MODEL = "sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2"; MODEL_REVISION = "1110a243fdf4706b3f48f1d95db1a4f5529b4d41"
assert subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(checkout), "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip() == COMMIT
sys.path.insert(0, str(checkout / "support")); sys.path.insert(0, str(checkout / "support" / "clustering"))
import numpy as np
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer
import weekly_hdbscan
assert pathlib.Path(weekly_hdbscan.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(checkout)

csv.field_size_limit(10**9)
data = checkout / "data/final_trendingtopics_reddit.csv"
rows = list(csv.DictReader(open(data, encoding="utf-8")))
posts = []
for r in rows:
    ts = datetime.strptime(r["timestamp_utc"], "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S").replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    text = r["text_translated"] or r["full_text"]
    posts.append({"id": r["post_id"], "niche": r["niche"], "published_at": int(ts.timestamp()),
                  "week": int(ts.isocalendar().week), "text": text})
with open(out / "posts.jsonl", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    for p in posts: f.write(json.dumps(p, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")

model = SentenceTransformer(MODEL, revision=MODEL_REVISION, device="cpu")
t0 = time.time()
emb = model.encode([p["text"] for p in posts], batch_size=32, convert_to_numpy=True, show_progress_bar=False)
embed_seconds = time.time() - t0

def groups(setting):
    g = {}
    for i, p in enumerate(posts):
        k = (p["niche"], p["week"]) if setting == "niche_week" else ("ALL", p["week"])
        g.setdefault(k, []).append(i)
    return g

result = {"setting": {}}
for setting in ["niche_week", "pooled_week"]:
    runs = []
    for (niche, week), idx in sorted(groups(setting).items()):
        if len(idx) < 12:  # the donor's HDBSCAN cannot form a cluster below min_cluster_size + UMAP minimum
            runs.append({"niche": niche, "week": week, "posts": [posts[i]["id"] for i in idx], "skipped": "TOO_FEW_POSTS"}); continue
        t = time.time()
        labels, prob, _ = weekly_hdbscan.cluster_embeddings(emb[idx])
        runs.append({"niche": niche, "week": week, "posts": [posts[i]["id"] for i in idx],
                     "labels": [int(x) for x in labels], "probabilities": [round(float(x), 6) for x in prob],
                     "seconds": round(time.time() - t, 3)})
    result["setting"][setting] = runs
result.update({"donor_id": "t4niha--Trend-Finder", "commit_sha": COMMIT, "model": MODEL, "model_revision": MODEL_REVISION,
               "data_blob": subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(checkout), "rev-parse", f"{COMMIT}:data/final_trendingtopics_reddit.csv"], text=True).strip(),
               "posts": len(posts), "embed_seconds": round(embed_seconds, 1)})
(out / "donor.json").write_text(json.dumps(result))
print("posts", len(posts), "embed s", round(embed_seconds, 1))
harness_sources.evaluate.py:
"""Scores the Trend-Finder clustering benchmark (donor.json, ecdev.json) and writes the record.

python -I evaluate.py <out dir> <record.json>
Ground truth is a proxy, stated as such: product-line labels from brand/model mentions (a post
is labelled only when exactly one family matches), plus pairs of posts linking the same external
URL. Product labels come from tokens, which favours lexical clustering; the result is a
benchmark answer under that proxy, not topic truth.
"""
import hashlib, itertools, json, pathlib, re, statistics, sys
from collections import Counter
out = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]); record = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2])
posts = {json.loads(l)["id"]: json.loads(l) for l in open(out / "posts.jsonl", encoding="utf-8")}
donor = json.loads((out / "donor.json").read_text()); ecdev = json.loads((out / "ecdev.json").read_text())
FAMILIES = {
    "apple-iphone": r"\biphone", "apple-ipad": r"\bipad", "apple-mac": r"\bmacbook|\bimac\b|\bmac (mini|studio|pro)\b",
    "apple-watch": r"\bapple watch", "apple-airpods": r"\bairpods", "samsung-galaxy": r"\bgalaxy\b|\bsamsung\b",
    "google-pixel": r"\bpixel\b", "oneplus": r"\boneplus\b", "xiaomi": r"\bxiaomi\b|\bredmi\b|\bpoco\b",
    "nothing": r"\bnothing phone\b|\bcmf\b", "motorola": r"\bmotorola\b|\bmoto [gex]\d*\b|\brazr\b",
    "huawei-honor": r"\bhuawei\b|\bhonor\b", "oppo-vivo-realme": r"\boppo\b|\bvivo\b|\brealme\b", "sony-xperia": r"\bxperia\b",
    "nintendo": r"\bnintendo\b|\bswitch 2\b", "playstation": r"\bps5\b|\bplaystation\b", "xbox": r"\bxbox\b",
    "steam-hardware": r"\bsteam deck\b|\bsteam machine\b", "nvidia-gpu": r"\bnvidia\b|\brtx\b|\bgeforce\b", "tesla": r"\btesla\b",
}
COMMERCE_NICHES = {"smartphones", "technology", "gaming"}
def family(p):
    if p["niche"] not in COMMERCE_NICHES: return None
    t = p["text"].lower(); hits = [f for f, rx in FAMILIES.items() if re.search(rx, t)]
    return hits[0] if len(hits) == 1 else None
fam = {i: family(p) for i, p in posts.items()}

def clusters_of(run):
    """Clusters of size >= 2 (donor noise -1 and ECDEV singletons are unclustered)."""
    g = {}
    for pid, l in zip(run["posts"], run["labels"]):
        if l != -1: g.setdefault(l, []).append(pid)
    return [m for m in g.values() if len(m) >= 2]

def score(runs):
    same = co_same = co_labelled = labelled_pairs = 0; clustered = total = 0; sizes = []; seconds = 0.0
    mixed = 0; majority = 0
    for run in runs:
        if "labels" not in run: total += len(run["posts"]); continue
        seconds += run["seconds"]; total += len(run["posts"]); cs = clusters_of(run)
        cid = {pid: k for k, m in enumerate(cs) for pid in m}
        clustered += len(cid); sizes += [len(m) for m in cs]
        for m in cs:
            niches = Counter(posts[p]["niche"] for p in m); majority += niches.most_common(1)[0][1]; mixed += len(niches) > 1
        labelled = [p for p in run["posts"] if fam[p]]
        for a, b in itertools.combinations(labelled, 2):
            together = a in cid and cid.get(a) == cid.get(b)
            if fam[a] == fam[b]: same += 1; co_same += together
            co_labelled += together; labelled_pairs += 1
    return {"posts": total, "clusters": len(sizes), "coverage": round(clustered / total, 4),
            "median_cluster_size": statistics.median(sizes) if sizes else 0, "max_cluster_size": max(sizes, default=0),
            "product_pair_recall": round(co_same / same, 4) if same else None,
            "product_pair_precision": round(co_same / co_labelled, 4) if co_labelled else None,
            "product_pairs": same, "chance_precision": round(same / labelled_pairs, 4) if labelled_pairs else None,
            "product_pair_f1": round(2 * co_same / (same + co_labelled), 4) if same + co_labelled else None, "niche_purity": round(majority / clustered, 4) if clustered else None,
            "mixed_niche_clusters": mixed, "cluster_seconds": round(seconds, 3)}

def ari(runs_a, runs_b):
    from sklearn.metrics import adjusted_rand_score
    a_lab, b_lab = [], []
    for ra, rb in zip(runs_a, runs_b):
        if "labels" not in ra: continue
        assert ra["posts"] == rb["posts"]
        a_lab += [f"{ra['niche']}{ra['week']}:{l}" if l != -1 else f"noise:{p}" for p, l in zip(ra["posts"], ra["labels"])]
        b_lab += [f"{rb['niche']}{rb['week']}:{l}" for l in rb["labels"]]
    return round(adjusted_rand_score(a_lab, b_lab), 4)

result = {}
for setting in ["niche_week", "pooled_week"]:
    d, e = donor["setting"][setting], ecdev[setting]
    e_runs = [x for x in e if any(x["posts"] == r["posts"] for r in d if "labels" in r)]
    d_runs = [r for r in d if "labels" in r]
    result[setting] = {"groups": len(d_runs), "skipped_groups": len(d) - len(d_runs),
                       "trend_finder_umap_hdbscan": score(d_runs), "ecdev_lexical": score(e_runs),
                       "adjusted_rand_between_methods": ari(d_runs, e_runs)}
here = pathlib.Path(__file__).parent
sources = {n: (here / n).read_text() for n in ["donor_side.py", "evaluate.py"]}
sources["ecdev_side/src/main.rs"] = (here / "ecdev_side/src/main.rs").read_text()
record.write_text(json.dumps({
    "benchmark": "social.trend-finder.cluster_embeddings: do sentence embeddings with UMAP + HDBSCAN recover commerce topics that ECDEV's lexical clustering misses, without merging unrelated ones?",
    "donor_id": donor["donor_id"], "commit_sha": donor["commit_sha"], "license": "MIT",
    "embedding_model": {"id": donor["model"], "revision": donor["model_revision"], "license": "apache-2.0"},
    "corpus": {"source": "data/final_trendingtopics_reddit.csv in the pinned donor (not copied into ECDEV)", "blob": donor["data_blob"],
               "posts": donor["posts"], "labelled_product_posts": sum(1 for v in fam.values() if v)},
    "ground_truth": "PROXY: product-line labels from brand/model mentions in smartphones, technology and gaming posts (exactly one family); token-derived labels favour lexical clustering",
    "evidence_state": "BENCHMARK_MEASUREMENT on a fixed public corpus; not evidence about any market, demand or product",
    "embed_seconds_cpu": donor["embed_seconds"], "results": result,
    "outputs_sha256": {n: hashlib.sha256((out / n).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for n in ["donor.json", "ecdev.json", "posts.jsonl"]},
    "harness_sources": sources}, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
print(json.dumps(result, indent=1))

findings: Per (niche, week), the donor's UMAP + HDBSCAN clusters 74% of posts but groups same-product-line pairs at precision 0.29 against a chance rate of 0.19 (recall 0.26): its clusters are topics (leaks, reviews, deals) that cut across brands, not product lines
Pooled across niches per week it reaches recall 0.88 only by merging: one 938-post cluster, 68 mixed-niche clusters, niche purity 0.73; embedding clusters must never pool unrelated communities

ECDEV's lexical clustering is exact (precision 1.0, niche purity 1.0 per niche-week) but links 0.3% of same-product pairs and clusters 10% of posts, at most 7 posts per cluster: it finds near-duplicates, not product topics
The two methods barely agree (adjusted Rand 0.005): they measure different things
Cost on CPU: 114 s to embed 7,090 posts plus 23 s of clustering, against 1.8 s for lexical clustering

decision.social.trend-finder.cluster_embeddings: STUDY_COMPLETE[DELIBERATE_SEMANTIC_DIVERGENCE]: embedding + HDBSCAN clusters are not adopted as product topics (precision about 1.5x chance on product lines); topic clusters stay a possible presentation layer, never evidence
decision.follow_up: ECDEV-native: product topics need product-family entity links (brand/model recognition with provenance) rather than either clustering; ECDEV lexical recall of 0.003 shows the gap
